name: Strong Woman Do Bong-Soon
description: Born with supernatural strength, Bong-soon fights evil and procures justice while getting tangled in a love triangle with her CEO boss and cop crush.

videos.title: Special
videos.overview: The special episode reveals behind-the-scenes stories from the actors during filming and a special commentary interview with the actors of the show.

videos.title: Ridiculous Punks
videos.overview: For generations, a superpower has been passed down the maternal line in Bong-soon's family. But for 27 years, she has always tried to keep it hidden.

videos.title: A Criminal's Heart
videos.overview: As Min-hyuk spends the day shopping and playing, Bong-soon is forced to follow him around. While at a park, they spot a suspicious man spying on them.

videos.title: That Jerk's Secret
videos.overview: Bong-soon finds a painting in Min-hyuk's closet that seems out of place. The next day, the two visit the owner of the motorcycle they saw at the park.

videos.title: Her True Identity
videos.overview: Bong-soon struggles to control not just her power, but also her emotions. To make matters worse, Min-hyuk keeps giving her a hard time.

videos.title: Seems As If They're a Friend, and Yet Not
videos.overview: The criminal at large seems to be attacking only certain people. Concerned for Bong-soon's safety, Min-hyuk and Guk-doo clash over how to protect her.

videos.title: Happy Together
videos.overview: Not able to trust one another overnight, Bong-soon, Min-hyuk and Guk-doo decide to play games instead, evoking the two men's competitive spirits.

videos.title: Changes
videos.overview: Osung Group's shareholders get angry when Min-hyuk fails to show up on time to the meeting to discuss his qualifications as the next company leader.

videos.title: One Step Closer
videos.overview: Profilers suggest misogyny motivated the recent crimes. Bong-soon decides to put her dream of developing games second to catching the culprit.

videos.title: Love Risking One's Life
videos.overview: Both Min-hyuk and Guk-doo arrive at the fight scene just before one of Baek Tak's men starts running toward Bong-soon with a dagger in hand.

videos.title: Find A Hidden Heart
videos.overview: Frustrated with police legalism, Guk-doo takes drastic measures. Bong-soon is preoccupied with catching the culprit herself, which worries Min-hyuk.

videos.title: Timing
videos.overview: With the kidnapping case still unsolved and both Min-hyuk and Guk-doo asking to see her that night, Bong-soon finds her life is full of dilemmas.

videos.title: Help Me
videos.overview: Guk-doo's police team keeps hitting roadblocks while chasing down their suspect. Bong-soon senses something is off from Kyung-shim's text messages.

videos.title: Nevertheless
videos.overview: Replaying the video of Kyung-shim, Bong-soon hears a strange background noise. Following his hunch, Guk-doo decides to check out the junkyard again.

videos.title: A Prelude to the Battle
videos.overview: When Bong-soon doesn't come home late into the night, her dad gets worried. Guk-doo is conflicted over what to include on Kyung-shim's case report.

videos.title: Level Up
videos.overview: With the case unresolved, Guk-doo's team visits Min-hyuk's company to gather clues. Guk-doo hears from Bong-soon the details of last night's events.

videos.title: Final
videos.overview: As Bong-soon prepares to launch her online game inspired by her own story, she no longer feels ashamed to be her "special" self offline as well.
